cases.claim: The private Grammar 9 capability is identity checked and absent from public facades.
Grammar 1 through 8 delegate to the active parser without a planning model.
Incomplete Work projects stable local and qualified identities without execution state.
Project-owned Event and Activity fragments preserve complete endpoints and allow planning cycles.
All Work occurs exactly once in the singleton project-wide work order.
Associations, strict projection links, last-consumer ownership, and qualified references are validated.
Work dependencies reject self and duplicate references while retaining directed cycles as observations.
Activity candidate plan fields retain exact values without becoming strict Tasks.
Persisted Windows require objective, members, compatible ordered bounds, and many-to-many membership.
Planning entities share the local namespace with every active entity kind and reject qualified source references.
BOM and CRLF inputs retain exact UTF-16 source spans and total diagnostic counts.
The source-preserving formatter canonicalizes owned scalar values and is idempotent.
Grammar 8 to 9 migration changes only the explicit project version and is idempotent.
Source and entity hard limits fail closed with PTPOOL-115.
Complete requested edits are revalidated before a private candidate is returned.
Package, Grammar 8, Contract 9, commands, schemas, and facade counts remain unchanged.
